summary: New content added to the NVIDIA Developer website, including learning pathways, tutorials, news, training, and on-demand videos

change_summary.what_changed: New content added to the NVIDIA Developer website, including learning pathways, tutorials, news, training, and on-demand videos
specific_changes: Introduction of a new learning pathway for deploying accelerated AI models
Addition of tutorials on optimizing LLMs, securing agentic AI, and using CI/CD for network configuration
New releases of various NVIDIA tools and software, including CUDA Toolkit, DLSS, and HPC SDK
Introduction of new training courses and resources, including instructor-led workshops and self-paced courses
Addition of on-demand videos from GTC Top Talks, covering topics such as quantum computing, AI, and robotics
